issues.legal_issue: A subsequent purchaser has no locus to challenge land acquisition proceedings or seek their lapse under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
The decision in Government (NCT of Delhi) v. Manav Dharam Trust is per incuriam on the issue of a subsequent purchaser’s standing to seek lapse of acquisition proceedings.
